title: BlockStop
description: Stops you from breaking blocks you don't want to break
body:
# BlockStop
![Time](https://hackatime-badge.hackclub.com/U0922GMGGTU/BlockStop)

This mod is made for players who accidentally break blocks, they don't want.
\
With this mod, you can block yourself from breaking a block, by selecting it in the ModMenu config.

## Building
```shell
git clone https://codeberg.org/JGJ52/BlockStop.git
cd BlockStop
./gradlew build
```
The output will be in versions/[version]/build/libs/blockstop-1.0.jar
